title: Member Equities & Patronage Payment Election Terms — How Payouts on a Holding Are Made
content:
The member chooses how payouts on a Member Equities & Patronage holding are made — cash patronage, retirement proceeds or preferred dividends — only on their own instruction.

## Terms of the election

1. **Open holdings only.** A payment preference may be changed only while the holding is in subscribed, active or retirement requested status. The status is read from the association's record of the holding the election is made on, before the change is recorded.
2. **Direct deposit.** Direct deposit requires the last four digits of the checking account, recorded exactly as the member gives them.
3. **Applying cash to a loan.** Applying cash to a loan is available only on a class on which cash may be applied to a loan, and the chosen loan must be one of the member's own operating lines, equipment loans, farm real estate loans or Country Home loans in an open status, named with its line.
4. **Dividend option.** The dividend option (cash or reinvest) may be set only on preferred stock.
5. **When a change takes effect.** Changes take effect for payouts as the cash patronage payment terms provide.

The methods a holding may carry are a check, a direct deposit or a principal payment applied to a loan; a change records the method, the last four digits of the deposit account for direct deposit, the loan and its line for cash applied to a loan, and, on preferred stock, the dividend option.

## Open status of the chosen loan

- Operating Lines of Credit: applied, active, suspended or matured;
- Equipment & Vehicle Loans: applied, active, deferred or nonaccrual;
- Farm Real Estate Loans: applied, active or nonaccrual;
- Rural Home Loans (the Country Home loans): applied, active, forbearance or nonaccrual.

## Hypothetical elections

| Holding and request | Outcome under these terms |
|---|---|
| Active Qualified Allocated Surplus holding; member asks for direct deposit to the account ending 4417 | Recorded with last four digits 4417 |
| Active Qualified Allocated Surplus holding; member asks to apply cash to their own active farm real estate loan | Recorded with that loan and the farm real estate line |
| Active Class B Voting Stock holding; member asks to apply proceeds to a loan | Not available on that class |
| Retired Nonqualified Allocated Surplus holding; member asks for direct deposit | Not changed: the holding is not in subscribed, active or retirement requested status |
| Active Class H Preferred Stock holding; member asks to reinvest dividends | Dividend option set to reinvest |
